allow: Allow routine local development for the user-authorized task inside the assigned repository or worktree, including creating, editing, and deleting pre-existing source code, tests, and documentation; building, testing, linting, formatting, and managing project dependencies. Exclude credentials, safety controls, files outside the assigned workspace, shared infrastructure, and production systems.
Allow commits and non-force pushes to the task's non-default working branch. Exclude history rewrites, branch deletion,and direct pushes to the default branch.
